promote.title: Add as training pattern
promote.description: This message is added as a pattern to the intent you pick and removed from unknown messages.
promote.feedbackDescription: The reader's question is added as a pattern to the intent you pick and the reply leaves the review queue.

intents.tagHelper: Lowercase words joined by underscores, e.g. book_search.
intents.noPatterns: No patterns yet. Add one below.
intents.patternsAfterCreate: You can add patterns after you create the intent.
intents.deleteConfirm: Delete "{{tag}}"? Its patterns and responses are deleted too. This can't be undone.
intents.patternHelper: Something a reader might type, up to {{max}} characters. Each pattern belongs to one intent.
intents.handledHint: Replies come from the catalogue and the reader's shelves; responses are not used.
intents.overlapSummary_one: {{count}} pattern is very close to a pattern of another intent in the last index build. Rephrase or move it, then rebuild the index.
intents.overlapSummary_other: {{count}} patterns are very close to patterns of other intents in the last index build. Rephrase or move them, then rebuild the index.

responses.responseHelper: What the chatbot replies when it recognises this intent.
responses.intentLocked: A response stays with the intent it was created for.
responses.deleteConfirm: Delete this response from "{{tag}}"? This can't be undone.
responses.languageHelper: Readers get replies in their interface language, or English when there is none.
responses.handledNote: This intent is answered by code from the catalogue, so its responses are not shown to readers.

note.done: Index saved. New chat messages use it immediately.
note.error: Training failed. Check the error lines in the log.

training.emptyIdle: Logs appear here once training starts.

log.done: Index saved: {{accuracy}}% cross-validated accuracy over {{intents}} intents.

training.description: Rebuild the index after changing patterns. Every pattern is turned into a multilingual sentence vector, then the index is scored with 5-fold cross-validation.

validation.tagPattern: Use lowercase letters, numbers and underscores, starting with a letter.
validation.importSize: The file must be at most {{chatbotImportMaxMb}} MB.
validation.importJson: This file isn't a valid intents export. It must contain a JSON list of intents.

import.title: Import intents
import.description: Load intents from a JSON file in the seed format, such as an export from another database.
import.fileHelper: A .json export of up to {{max}} MB.

modes.mergeHint: Keep the current intents and add the patterns and responses that are missing.
modes.replaceHint: Make the intents match the file exactly. Intents that aren't in the file are deleted.

import.done: Imported {{intents}} intents, {{patterns}} patterns and {{responses}} responses. Rebuild the index to use them.
import.rebuildNote: Imported patterns are used once you rebuild the index on the Training tab.

test.description: Type a message to see how the chatbot classifies it. Nothing is stored and no reply is sent.
test.placeholder: e.g. what should I read next?
test.helper: Write it as a reader would, up to {{max}} characters.
test.fallback: The chatbot would fall back: no intent is confident enough.
test.tooLong: Patterns are limited to {{max}} characters. Shorten the message to add it.
test.empty: The closest intents and their scores appear here.
test.promoteDescription: The message is added as a pattern of the intent you pick. Rebuild the index to use it.
test.added: Added as a pattern of "{{tag}}". Rebuild the index to use it.

totals.messagesHint: Replies the chatbot sent in this period.

captions.fallbackRate: Share of replies each week where no intent was confident enough.
captions.unknowns: New unknown messages recorded each week.
captions.helpful: Share of rated replies each week that got a thumbs up.

empty.unknowns: No new unknown messages in this period.
empty.helpful: No thumbs-up ratings in this period.

analytics.intentsEmpty: No recognised messages in this period.
